releaseNotes:
fix: use ActivityCompat.requestPermissions to pass lintVitalRelease

registerForActivityResult triggered InvalidFragmentVersionForActivityResult
(fatal in lintVitalRelease), failing the release build. Switched to
ActivityCompat.requestPermissions — same effect, no fragment dependency, no lint error.
